en: A wooden stick used to hit the ball in baseball or cricket; or a small flying animal that comes out at night; or to hit with a bat.
ex: The batter swung the bat and hit the ball.
打擊手揮棒擊中了球。

en: The act of washing your body in water; or a large container you wash in.
ex: I take a hot bath every evening.
我每天晚上都泡熱水澡。

en: A room with a bath or shower and often a toilet.
ex: May I use the bathroom, please?
請問我可以用洗手間嗎？

en: Used to describe what someone or something is, or to show where they are.
ph: to be or not to be
ex: Please be quiet in the library.
請在圖書館保持安靜。

en: An area of sand or small stones next to the sea.
ex: The children are playing on the beach.
孩子們在海灘上玩耍。

en: A small seed or pod of a plant that is eaten as a vegetable.
ex: She cooked green beans with garlic.
她用大蒜炒了四季豆。

en: A large, heavy wild animal with thick fur; or to accept or tolerate something difficult; or to carry.
ex: I can't bear the noise any longer.
我再也無法忍受這噪音了。

en: Very attractive and pleasing to look at or listen to.
ex: What a beautiful garden you have!
你的花園好漂亮！

en: For the reason that; used to give an explanation.
ex: I stayed home because I was sick.
我因為生病而待在家裡。

en: To start to be something; or to change into something different.
ex: She wants to become a doctor one day.
她想有一天成為醫生。

en: A piece of furniture that you sleep on; or the ground under a river or sea.
ex: I go to bed at ten o'clock every night.
我每晚十點上床睡覺。

en: A room in a house where you sleep.
ex: Her bedroom is on the second floor.
她的臥室在二樓。

en: A flying insect that makes honey and can sting.
ex: The bees were buzzing around the flowers.
蜜蜂在花朵周圍嗡嗡飛舞。

en: The meat from a cow; or to complain about something (informal).
ex: We had beef and rice for dinner.
我們晚餐吃牛肉和米飯。

en: Earlier than something; or in front of something.
ex: Wash your hands before you eat.
吃東西前要洗手。

en: To start doing something; or to start to happen.
ex: The class begins at nine o'clock.
課程九點開始。

en: At the back of someone or something; or late in doing something.
ex: The cat is hiding behind the sofa.
貓躲在沙發後面。

en: To think that something is true or that someone is honest.
ex: I believe you are telling the truth.
我相信你說的是實話。

en: A hollow metal object that makes a ringing sound when hit; or the sound it makes.
ex: The school bell rang at noon.
學校鐘聲在中午響起。

en: To be owned by someone; or to be a member or part of a group.
ex: This book belongs to my sister.
這本書是我姊姊的。

en: At a lower level than something.
ex: The temperature fell below zero last night.
昨晚氣溫降到零度以下。

en: A strip of leather or cloth worn around the waist; or a long, narrow area of land.
ex: Fasten your seat belt before the car starts.
車子發動前請繫好安全帶。

en: A long seat for two or more people, usually outdoors; or a strong table for working.
ex: The old man sat on a bench in the park.
老人坐在公園的長椅上。

en: At the side of someone or something; very near.
ex: She sat beside her mother on the sofa.
她坐在沙發上母親的旁邊。

en: Of the highest quality; better than all others.
ex: She is the best student in the class.
她是班上最好的學生。

en: In the space that separates two things, people or places.
ex: The school is between the park and the library.
學校位於公園和圖書館之間。

en: A two-wheeled vehicle that you ride by pushing the pedals with your feet.
ex: I ride my bicycle to school every day.
我每天騎腳踏車上學。

en: Large in size, amount or importance.
ex: They live in a big house near the lake.
他們住在湖邊的一棟大房子裡。

en: An animal with feathers and wings that can usually fly.
ex: A little bird sat on the branch and sang.
一隻小鳥停在樹枝上歌唱。

en: To cut something with the teeth; or when an insect or snake injures with a sting or fang; or a small amount of food.
ex: The dog bit the postman's leg.
那隻狗咬了郵差的腿。

en: The color of coal or the night sky; or the darkest color.
ex: She wore a black dress to the party.
她穿著黑色洋裝去參加派對。

en: Not able to see; or unable to notice something; or a covering for a window.
ex: The old man is blind and uses a stick to walk.
那位老人是盲人，靠拐杖走路。

en: A large piece of something solid; or a group of buildings between streets; or to stop something from moving.
ex: A fallen tree blocked the road.
一棵倒下的樹擋住了道路。

en: To send out air from the mouth; or when wind moves; or a hard hit or shock.
ex: She blew out the candles on her cake.
她吹熄了蛋糕上的蠟燭。

en: The color of the sky on a clear day; or feeling sad.
ex: The sky was a clear, bright blue.
天空是晴朗明亮的藍色。

en: A small vehicle that travels on water.
ex: We crossed the lake in a small boat.
我們乘小船渡過了湖。

en: The whole physical structure of a person or animal; or the main part of something.
ex: Exercise is good for your body and mind.
運動對你的身心都有益。

en: A set of printed pages bound together; or to arrange to have a room or ticket in advance.
ex: I borrowed a book from the library.
我從圖書館借了一本書。

en: Feeling tired and unhappy because something is not interesting or you have nothing to do.
ex: The students were bored during the long lecture.
學生們在冗長的講課中感到無聊。

en: Not interesting; making you feel tired or impatient.
ex: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep.
這部電影太無聊，我睡著了。
